_readme: One place for every share card, favicon and theme-color tag. Swap files in public/, bump `version` (e.g. 4) so X/WhatsApp/iMessage refetch, then build + deploy. index.html's <!-- share:begin/end --> block and the /suomi page are both rendered from this file. v3 (30 Oct 2026): Iris's approved card + 'Record P' favicon; /suomi shares the main card and icons.
